Name: Genderbent Dialogue
Author: SlushieSlowpoke
Description:
With all the genderbent mods coming out I figured I would help out the community by doing some of the dirty work.

This mod affects only three bacheorlettes; Abigail, Maru, and Leah. This also changes dialogue of other npcs so that they're referred to by the correct gender. (ie. Sebby calls Maru "Martin" and "brother")

Feel free to do as you please; edit, copy, distribute, etc. I don't care about credit with these little files; I just want to help y'all out. <3
If you do wish to edit I used these instructions to edit the game's files: http://imgur.com/gallery/WCfeO

Abigail = Adam
Maru = Martin
Leah = Liam

I may be updating this from time to time; eventually I hope to have dialogue flipped for all characters. Plus future updates may require me to patch this up now and again. Feel free to go on and build upon this though <3
